description: This file defines a Spring Boot REST controller named RouteController. It handles HTTP requests related to route optimization, specifically exposing an endpoint '/route/optimize' that receives a RouteRequest and returns an optimized route via the RouteService.

classes.name: RouteController
classes.description: A REST controller in a Spring Boot application that manages route optimization endpoints.

methods.name: optimize
methods.description: Handles POST requests to '/route/optimize', processes a RouteRequest, and returns the optimized route or an error response.
